message.content: On August 6, 2026, at 16:30, Turalyon announced that the team is exploring the incorporation of sustainable practices such as recycling and composting into the garden renovation project. Specifically, they aim to introduce recycling bins and a composting area, which would facilitate the eco-friendly management of waste within the garden. Additionally, Turalyon suggested including educational signage about the benefits of recycling and composting to enhance community awareness and participation. These sustainable additions aim to not only improve the environmental impact of the garden but also educate and engage the community in environmentally conscious practices.
